decision: Selected the mean position of the six data-building labels D1-D6 on Red Admiral DC Ltd's planning master plan (Halston drawing CLDC-HAL-DC-XX-PL-1000 rev P01, 'Proposed Master Plan Site Layout Admiral and Solar Farm', EIAR Volume 3 Appendix 2.1), registered to ITM with the six survey stations whose ITM coordinates are printed on the same drawing, as the campus locator replacing the imported Rochfortbridge village point.
source_location: PDF page 36 (A0 sheet, displayed 3370 x 2384 pt): drawing CLDC-HAL-DC-XX-PL-1000, client RED ADMIRAL DC LTD, project ADMIRAL, Sep 2024, stage PLANNING, received stamp 08/07/2025; 'Data Campus Equipment Legend' D1-D6 = Data Building 01-06
method: Word bounding boxes from pdftotext -bbox (poppler) on PDF page 36. Control points: the survey-station annotations S02, S03, S05, S06, S07 and S08, each printed with its ITM easting and northing (EPSG:2157) at the station position. A least-squares affine transformation from page points to ITM was fitted to the six stations; data-building positions are the centres of the D1-D6 label words inside the building outlines; their ITM mean was transformed to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (EPSG:2157 -> EPSG:4326) and rounded to 7 decimals.
corroboration: The EIAR addendum (redadmiral-eiar-34.pdf, March 2026, section 2.2) says the project site lies midway between Rochfortbridge and Tyrrellspass, that the M6 defines the southern boundary of the DC facility campus and the R446 its northern boundary, and that the fuel-cell and BESS assets extend east of the DC facility around the Castlelost Flexgen plant and GIS substation; the six data buildings on the drawing lie between the labelled R446 and M6, west of the Flexgen compound.
exclusions: The point marks the six-building data campus, not the 243 ha overall boundary, the solar farm to the east, the DER compounds, the Castlelost Flexgen plant or any single building. Label centres approximate building centres. No map service, geocoder, village centre or basemap is used; the drawing is registered only by coordinates printed on it.
